items.quote: 39:42 According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
items.claim: The children of Israel made all the work in line with everything the LORD commanded Moses.
items.object: all the work (the text does not say which; the idea that it means the tabernacle comes only from model-prior and is unverified)
items.mechanism: they followed what the LORD commanded Moses
